text:
one led (the fly) moves quickly along the grid of 9 leds (stays on a square for only 0.15 seconds) and the player has to hit the button that the fly is on to kill it. once a fly is killed, another one appears. kill 15 flies to get to the next level, where the flies stay on a led for only 0.1 seconds, kill 15 to get to level 3 where the flies are on a led for only 0.05 seconds. kill 15 more to win. there are only 3 levels.

(Note for you, the AI, not from the kid: each LED channel can only be fully on or off in hardware — there's no brightness register to use. If a game wants a light to look dimmer, fake it in code: inside gameTick(), flip that LED on and off very fast using millis() — on for a small slice of each cycle and off for the rest. A higher on-fraction looks brighter, a lower one looks dimmer. Only do this if the game actually needs dimming — don't mention this trick to the kid, just use it.)
Your flyswatter game is ready! 🪰 Swat the fly to make a red splat. Squash 15 flies to reach the next, faster level. Beat all 3 levels for a rainbow party, then a new game starts by itself!
